title: Draft for 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25
summary: Listed automatically from official feeds. Not reviewed. Each item quotes its source; check it before it moves into a published digest.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.304
items.text: Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
candidateLines: Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
Added decider: "person" to a mod's tool.check answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
Added e.isReadOnly to a mod's tool.check event, set when the tool call is read-only

items.title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
items.text: You can now use the REST API to retrieve and update Copilot model policies for enterprises, enterprise teams, agent apps, and organizations.
candidateLines: You can now use the REST API to retrieve and update Copilot model policies for enterprises, enterprise teams, agent apps, and organizations.

items.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026
items.text: As of today, October 19, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).
candidateLines: As of today, October 19, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.305
items.text: Added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
candidateLines: Added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS so unattended retry mode (CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset

Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of --tools (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.306
items.text: Fixed claude -p inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
candidateLines: Fixed claude -p inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.307
items.text: Added /claude-api api-version to move Claude API code to API version 2026-10-21
candidateLines: Added /claude-api api-version to move Claude API code to API version 2026-10-21
Added the claude_code.safety_event OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT is set and the model is an alias with the [1m] suffix, such as opus[1m]

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.308
candidateLines: Bug fixes and reliability improvements

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.309
items.text: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command
candidateLines: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command
Fixed macOS sandbox denyWrite glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink
Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with --mcp-config

items.title: ChatGPT for iOS
items.text: View and stop background commands from a new pill above the composer on supported remote hosts.
candidateLines: View and stop background commands from a new pill above the composer on supported remote hosts.
Mention chats from other connected hosts with @.
A loading indicator now shows when saved messages are refreshing.

items.title: Global default for Copilot features generally available
items.text: In September, we announced a global default policy for generally available GitHub Copilot features and supported client capabilities on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans.
candidateLines: In September, we announced a global default policy for generally available GitHub Copilot features and supported client capabilities on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans.

items.title: Industry comparisons in the Copilot impact dashboard
items.text: The Copilot impact dashboard now includes an “Industry comparison” section.
candidateLines: The Copilot impact dashboard now includes an “Industry comparison” section.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.310
items.text: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
candidateLines: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them
Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when cleanupPeriodDays is set to a very large value

items.title: Codex 0.164.0
items.text: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered /presets slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access.
candidateLines: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered /presets slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access.
Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline /model and /permissions arguments.
Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics.
